The '''CO-0012''' was a model of [[com-scan]] manufactured by [[MicroThrust Processors]]. The unit was used aboard the [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariot]] and other military command [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeders]]. The CO-0012 compiled and analyzed information from the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], vehicles, and forward observer stations under the theater commander's control, allowing enemy movements to be tracked. In-built communications encryption systems ensured that the information relayed between all the units was kept secure.<ref name="EGWT" />
